  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Main entry point of the application. Initializes the program execution by calling the main menu loop. Command line arguments passed to the application.

    • menu

      public static void menu()

    • registerZooInformation

      public static void registerZooInformation()
      Registers the general information of the zoo. -Description: The user for zoo details (name, city, address, legal representative data, and budget) -Precondition: The global variable myZoo must be null. User must input valid values (budget greater than 0). -Postcondition: The variable Zoo is created and assigned to myZoo.

    • showZooInformacion

      public static void showZooInformacion()
      Displays the general information of the zoo. -Description: Prints the details of the zoo if it has been previously initialized. -Precondition: The zoo must be initialized (`myZoo != null`). -Postcondition: The zoo details are printed to the console standard output.

    • modifyZoobudget

      public static void modifyZoobudget()
      Modifies the overall budget of the zoo. -Description: The user will enter in the terminal for a new budget amount and updates the zoo's budget attribute. -Precondition The zoo must be initialized (`myZoo != null`). -Postcondition: The zoo's budget property is updated with the new value provided by the user.

    • registerHabitat

      public static void registerHabitat()
      Registers a new habitat within the zoo. -Description: Requests habitat details (ID, name, environment type, temperature, area, max capacity, budget, and state) from the user, validating that the budget does not exceed constraints, and adds it to the zoo. -Precondition The zoo must be initialized (`myZoo != null`). Area must be greater than 0. Habitat budget cannot exceed the zoo budget or total available habitat budget pool. -Postcondition A new habitat is successfully registered and added to the zoo's habitat collection.

    • showAllHabitats

      public static void showAllHabitats()
      Displays a list of all registered habitats. -Description: Checks if there are available habitats and prints their summary list. -Precondition: The zoo must be initialized (`myZoo != null`). -Postcondition: Prints the list of habitats to the console if available.

    • modifyHabitat

      public static void modifyHabitat()
      Modifies the information of an existing habitat. -Description: Prompts the user for a habitat ID and new attributes (name, temperature, area, max capacity, budget, and state) to update the specified habitat. -Precondition: The zoo must be initialized and contain registered habitats. New area must be > 0. New budget must comply with zoo budget limits. -Postcondition: The target habitat properties are updated with the new user-provided values.

    • registerAnimal

      public static void registerAnimal()
      Registers a new animal within a specific habitat. -Description: Gathers animal details (ID, name, species, gender, weight, diet type, required environment, life stage, health status, and status) and assigns it to a chosen habitat. -Precondition: Habitats must be registered in the zoo. Weight must be greater than 0. -Postcondition: A new animal instance is created and added to the specified habitat if compatibility and capacity rules are met.

    • showAllAnimals

      public static void showAllAnimals()
      Displays a list of all registered animals across all habitats. -Description: Retrieves and prints the consolidated list of animals present in the zoo. -Precondition: The zoo must be initialized and contain valid habitats. -Postcondition: Prints the list of all registered animals to the console.

    • modifyAnimal

      public static void modifyAnimal()
      Modifies the information of an existing animal. -Description: Prompts for an animal ID and updates its weight, diet type, life stage, and health status. -Precondition: Animals must be registered in the zoo. New weight must be greater than 0. -Postcondition The specified animal attributes are updated with new values.

    • transferAnimalToHabitat

      public static void transferAnimalToHabitat()
      Transfers an animal from its current habitat to a target habitat. -Description: Asks for an animal ID and a destination habitat ID, then processes the relocation. -Precondition: Animals and target habitats must exist within the zoo system. -Postcondition: The animal is moved to the target habitat if capacity and environmental compatibility allow it.

    • removeAnimal

      public static void removeAnimal()
      Retires or removes an animal from a habitat. -Description: Gathers retirement details (animal ID, reason, status type, and date) and removes the animal from active habitat tracking. -Precondition Animal must exist in the system. -Postcondition The animal status is updated with retirement data and removed from its habitat list.

    • showAnimalMonthlyCost

      public static void showAnimalMonthlyCost()
      Calculates and displays the monthly food cost for a specific animal. -Description: Requests an animal name and prints its calculated monthly feeding cost. -Precondition: Animals must be registered in the zoo. -Postcondition: Computes and prints the monetary cost to the console.

    • registerEmployee

      public static void registerEmployee()
      Registers a new employee in the zoo. -Description: Prompts for employee information (ID, name, number, email, role, and state) and adds them. -Precondition: The zoo must be initialized (`myZoo != null`). -Postcondition: A new employee object is created and stored in the zoo's employee collection.

    • showAllEmployee

      public static void showAllEmployee()
      Displays a list of all registered employees. -Description: Prints the complete roster of employees currently registered in the zoo. -Precondition: The zoo must be initialized (`myZoo != null`). -Postcondition: Prints employee summary details to the console.

    • modifyEmployee

      public static void modifyEmployee()
      Modifies the information of an existing employee. -Description: Prompts for an employee ID and updates their contact info, role, and state. -Precondition: Employees must be registered in the system. -Postcondition The target employee attributes are updated with new values.

    • showZooFoodCost

      public static void showZooFoodCost()
      Displays consolidated food cost estimates for the entire zoo. -Description: Generates and prints a full breakdown report of feeding costs per habitat and total zoo cost. -Precondition: The zoo must be initialized and contain habitats/animals. -Postcondition Prints the complete food cost report to the console.

    • showHabitatOccupancy

      public static void showHabitatOccupancy()
      Displays the occupancy rate for a specific habitat. -Description: Prompts for a habitat ID and outputs its occupancy statistics and thresholds. -Precondition: Habitats must be registered in the zoo. -Postcondition Prints occupancy metrics for the selected habitat.

    • showActiveEmployees

      public static void showActiveEmployees()
      Displays a list of currently active employees. -Description: Filters and prints all zoo personnel whose state is set to ACTIVE. -Precondition Employees must be registered in the zoo. -Postcondition Prints the list of active employees to the console.

    • showCompleteHabitats

      public static void showCompleteHabitats()
      Displays comprehensive details of all habitats. -Description: Generates a full report including habitat attributes, assigned employees, and animal occupants. -Precondition: Habitats must be registered in the zoo. -Postcondition Prints the complete habitat report to the console.

    • showActiveAnimals

      public static void showActiveAnimals()
      Displays a list of all active animals in the zoo. -Description: Retrieves and prints a report of all animals whose state is active across all habitats. -Precondition: Animals must be registered in the system. -Postcondition: Prints the list of active animals grouped by habitat to the console.

    • showZooMap

      public static void showZooMap()
      Displays the map of the zoo. Preconditions: - The `myZoo` object must be initialized (not null).

    • saveData

      public static void saveData()
      Saves the current state of the zoo to a file using the DataManager. Preconditions: - The `myZoo` object must not be null before calling this method. Postconditions: - If the save operation is successful, a file is generated. - If an error occurs during the save operation, an appropriate error message is printed to the console. Error Handling: - Catches and prints stack traces for FileNotFoundException and IOException.
